D4 Compound Gear Trains: Working Backwards: practice

Booklet 5 Drive Systems · Lesson D4

← Back to Lessons

What this page practises

  • I can calculate the input speed of a gear train.
  • I can calculate the number of teeth on a gear.
  • I can explain why a compound gear train is used.
  • I can describe how to change the direction of the output.
D4 slides (PDF) D4 slides with answers (PDF)

Warm-up

Say it the exam way

Working backwards uses the relationship. Put in what you know, then for the unknown.

Gears on the same shaft turn at the same . A number of teeth is a with no unit.

A compound gear train gives a large reduction in speed using gears, so it fits in a small .

Each mesh the direction. To change the direction of the output, add an gear between two meshing gears.

Check your understanding

Answer in your jotter first. Then open the answer.

1. A 20-tooth driver gear meshes with a 60-tooth driven gear. The driven gear turns at 50 revs min⁻¹. Calculate the input speed.

Show the answer

input speed × 20 = 50 × 60, so input speed = 3000 ÷ 20 = 150 revs min⁻¹

2. A 15-tooth driver gear turns at 400 revs min⁻¹. The driven gear must turn at 100 revs min⁻¹. Calculate the number of teeth on the driven gear.

Show the answer

400 × 15 = 100 × teeth, so teeth = 6000 ÷ 100 = 60

3. Explain why a compound gear train is used instead of a simple gear train.

Show the answer

It uses smaller gears (cause), so it fits inside a small space (effect).

4. A gear train has three meshes. State if the output turns the same way as the input, or the opposite way.

Show the answer

The opposite way (an odd number of meshes).

5. Describe how to change the direction of the output without changing its speed.

Show the answer

Add an idler gear between two meshing gears.

6. A 12-tooth driver gear meshes with a 36-tooth gear that turns at 40 revs min⁻¹. Calculate the input speed.

Show the answer

input speed × 12 = 40 × 36, so input speed = 1440 ÷ 12 = 120 revs min⁻¹

Errors that cost marks

  • Start from the data booklet relationship and work one pair at a time. In 2024, pupils who used the gear ratio did less well (2024 course report).
  • Explain why compound: smaller gears (cause), so it fits in a small space (effect). "A high velocity ratio" got no mark (2023).
  • Say where the idler goes: between gears A and B, or between C and D. One mark is for the extra gear, one for its place (2021).
  • Write the unit as revs min⁻¹. "RPM" got no mark (2022, 2024).
  • The marking gives 1440 as 1400 revs min⁻¹, to 2 significant figures (2024).
  • Evaluate every specification point: met or not met, and why. Compare like with like: velocity ratio with velocity ratio (2024 assignment, Task 4a: 68%).

Answers

Say it the exam way

(1) same · (2) rearrange · (3) speed · (4) whole number · (5) smaller · (6) space · (7) reverses · (8) idler

Check your understanding

  1. input speed × 20 = 50 × 60, so input speed = 3000 ÷ 20 = 150 revs min⁻¹
  2. 400 × 15 = 100 × teeth, so teeth = 6000 ÷ 100 = 60
  3. It uses smaller gears (cause), so it fits inside a small space (effect).
  4. The opposite way (an odd number of meshes).
  5. Add an idler gear between two meshing gears.
  6. input speed × 12 = 40 × 36, so input speed = 1440 ÷ 12 = 120 revs min⁻¹
